input_text: Distributed caching layer for a read-heavy web application. Must handle 1M reads/second. Cache invalidation strategy needed (write-through, TTL). Redis cluster with sharding. Cache warming on deployment. Monitoring for cache hit rate.

Migrate a synchronous order processing pipeline to event-driven architecture. Currently: order → payment → fulfillment → notification (all synchronous HTTP calls). Must become: order events → payment service, fulfillment service consume asynchronously. Idempotency required for all consumers.
